services.name: View program
services.desc: Give the child you love a wildly creative and unforgettable summer experience at BAL! Early drop-off and after-care available at both the North Slope and South Slope locations. Every week, all students share what they've created in a Friday afternoon performance. Suggested program ages are flexible based on each child's needs and experience. Please contact BAL at admin@brooklynactinglab.org for questions, guidance or placement - we'd love to help! Young PLAYers Theater is an immersive, play-centered program where children dream up and bring to life their own theatrical worlds.
